confidence_notes: Coffee, beer, cocktail and meal anchors come from crowd-sourced Expatistan and Numbeo-derived figures plus some older Seattle reporting, so they are moderate quality. The wine glass anchor is weak: no current Seattle restaurant glass price was found, so it is set from the beer anchor and a national guide. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July Seattle demand, not checked against live listings. The FX observation is a cached RBA exchange-rates page snippet dated 2026-03-20. I could not confirm it is the latest published rate, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Seattle-specific sources. The wine glass is estimated at roughly 1.75 times the beer anchor, because direct Seattle restaurant glass data was not available. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Seattle urban hotel pricing in summer.
